messages:
Sanjay (Sales): heads-up — Telos (channel partner) asked to run a 2-week shared POC starting next Wed. They need: SSO (SAML), static egress IPs for allowlisting, a staging tenant, and a rough price for expected throughput. Who can take the tech handoff?
Monica (Partner Ops): I can own the tenant provisioning + entitlement flow. need partner billing contact and a signed MSA/DPA or at least a PO draft. @Alex can you confirm infra needs?
Alex (Solutions Eng): I can own the architecture/runbook. quick clarifying Qs for sizing: expected concurrency ~30 concurrent sessions? avg request ~500 tokens in + 250 tokens out? seq len ~1024? Those numbers will change infra and model choice.
Sanjay (Sales): close: partner estimates ~20-40 conc, typical prompts ~300 tokens in, ~200 out. they want 99.95% SLO and prefer open models but will consider Redwood curated variants.
Sarah (Security): security asks: completed security questionnaire, SOC2 attestation, SAML metadata (entityID + x509), IP allowlist (static egress), and minimum 90d log retention for audit. can we provide HSM/KMS integration notes? Also need contact for their infosec.
Tim (Infra): staging path: we can spin a sandbox tenant in us-west1. static egress requires either dedicated NAT under their VPC or using Dedicated capacity in our region (static IP pool). Dedicated is simpler for static IPs and SLOs. rough infra delta: sandbox hosted -> no static egress; Dedicated block ~+30% baseline on top of hosted runtime for guaranteed capacity.
Alex (Solutions Eng): suggested minimal stack for POC: 1) small dedicated pool (2x A10s or 1x A100 depending on model) 2) model: redwood-medium-quant or open-llama-13B-8bit 3) enable prefix KV caching for chat 4) token limits: 2k token window. I'll draft a short runbook. Example request for testing (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium-quant","input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":200}'
```
Monica (Partner Ops): partner also pushed a security questionnaire (they called it telos_poc_sec_q1). I'll upload answers once Sarah reviews. I have billing contact: finance@telos.co.
Sanjay (Sales): they asked for a ballpark cost for 100k generated tokens/day and 30 conc with 99.95 SLO (hosted vs dedicated). need something to show procurement.
Alex (Solutions Eng): rough back-of-envelope: 100k tokens/day ≈ 3M tokens/mo. hosted (mixed open model) rough estimate $8k–$15k/mo depending on model/quant. Dedicated baseline (reserved) for that concurrency + static IPs ~ $20k–$30k/mo. label these "estimates, subject to sizing and QoS." I'll annotate assumptions in the runbook.
OpsBot: Deployment event: staging-tenant 'st-teleos-2026' created by @Monica. id=st-teleos-2026, region=us-west1, status=ready
Sarah (Security): I'll take the questionnaire. please send telos_poc_sec_q1.xlsx and the partner's SAML metadata. Also confirm if we can provide IP ranges instead of individual addresses (they prefer ranges).
Tim (Infra): confirm: if they insist on single static IP per egress we should route them to Dedicated with NAT gateway. I'll prep the infra checklist (firewalls, allowed ports, certs).
Monica (Partner Ops): owners/next steps: @Monica -> provisioning + billing & MSA chase; @Alex -> runbook & model recommendation; @Sarah -> security questionnaire + certs; @Tim -> infra checklist + egress plan. I'll sync with partner and get SAML metadata + test user list by EOD tomorrow.
Sanjay (Sales): perfect. call out any blockers asap. Telos is sensitive to procurement timelines — if we can get the DPA + static IP plan in 3 business days they'll sign. :thumbsup:
Alex (Solutions Eng): adding small note: we'll include a fallback policy in the runbook to downgrade to smaller model if Dedicated capacity saturates (auto-fallback to hosted-compatible variant). I'll add the canary test steps and sample traffic loader script.
Monica (Partner Ops): copying partner contact: @telos-onboarding (external) — will share metadata. I'll post updates here after confirmation.
Sarah (Security): acked. I'll try to get SOC2 excerpt + KMS notes into the doc by tomorrow noon.
Tim (Infra): I'll share the infra checklist link shortly: https://internal.redwood/infrachecks/poc-egress (private).
Sanjay (Sales): thanks everyone — please @mention me when runbook + cost estimate ready. closing loop after provisioning. :rocket:
